criteria.requirement: Implement werkzeug.request_id.RequestIdMiddleware(app,*,factory=None). Accept incoming X-Request-ID only when it matches ASCII [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}, otherwise generate a UUID hex or injected factory value and validate it. Store werkzeug.request_id in environ and emit exactly one matching X-Request-ID response header, replacing application duplicates case-insensitively. Forward status, all other repeated headers, start_response exc_info and write return unchanged. Return original app iterable without pre-reading/wrapping so close and streaming/backpressure remain native. Propagate app errors; do not trust multiline header input or silently accept invalid factory results.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
